create_sequential_model: create a Sequential container that chains modules in order and forwards input through each module
build_module_list: build a ModuleList to hold and register submodules in an indexed list
create_module_dict: create a ModuleDict to hold and register submodules in an ordered dictionary
extend_sequential_with_modules: extend a Sequential container by appending modules from another Sequential or iterable
update_module_dict: update a ModuleDict with key-value pairs of string names and module instances
